name: Aam Aadmi Party
description: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) is an Indian political party founded in 2012 after the India Against Corruption movement. It emphasizes governance reforms, anti-corruption measures, transparency, education, healthcare, and public service delivery.
alliance: Contested different elections independently and as part of opposition alliances in some states.
achievements: Expansion of government schools in Delhi.
Reforms in Delhi's public healthcare through Mohalla Clinics and related initiatives.
Subsidised electricity for eligible households under state schemes.
Subsidised water supply for eligible households under state schemes.
Expansion of CCTV camera installation in Delhi.
Doorstep delivery of selected government services in Delhi.
Introduction of Happiness Curriculum in Delhi government schools.
Governed Punjab after winning the 2022 Assembly election.
criticisms: Critics have questioned the financial sustainability of some subsidy programmes.
The party has faced internal leadership disputes over time.
Some leaders have resigned or been expelled following disagreements.
The party and some of its leaders have faced legal investigations and court proceedings on various matters.
Opposition parties have criticised its governance on issues such as pollution, infrastructure and administrative coordination.
protests: Originated from the India Against Corruption movement (2011).
Participated in protests on governance, inflation and public policy issues.
Organised demonstrations regarding the powers of the Delhi Government.
majorSchemes: Women Free Bus Travel Scheme in Delhi
timeline: 2011 - India Against Corruption movement gains national attention.
2013 - Contested Delhi Assembly election and formed government for the first time.
2015 - Won a large majority in the Delhi Assembly election.
2020 - Returned to power in Delhi with another large majority.
2022 - Won Punjab Assembly election and formed the state government.

statesGoverned.status: Governed after multiple Assembly election victories

faqs.question: When was AAP founded?
faqs.answer: The Aam Aadmi Party was founded on 26 November 2012.

faqs.question: Who is the founder of AAP?
faqs.answer: Arvind Kejriwal is widely recognised as the principal founder, along with several other founding members.

faqs.question: Which movement led to the formation of AAP?
Which states has AAP governed?
faqs.answer: AAP has formed governments in Delhi and Punjab.
